# Tokens

Single repository owner of the visual token values, as a mirror of the Figma file `Design` ([ADR-031](design/adrs/ADR-031-figma-source-of-truth.md) § 8). Theme rules (follow the system, no dynamic color): [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) § Tokens.

| Token | Value | Android | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `motion/fast` | `150` | `DietaBotMotion.fast` | Duration 150 ms: press feedback, chip and toggle changes. |
